shared_elements: low relief carved on a flat stone surface
bird head shown in profile with prominent beak/eye
bag- or basket-like object with an arched handle
animal or animal-headed figures in profile
justification: The most specific correspondence is the profile bird head with a strongly hooked/pointed beak and a round eye, plus the presence in each of an arched-handled bag-like object and zones of repeated hatched banding. Otherwise the two are quite unlike: A is a shallow, flat, silhouette-like carving of several small scattered creatures spread across registers on an irregular pillar, while B is a single monumental, tightly modelled and densely detailed figure filling the whole rectangular slab.
